The '''1990–91 Division 1 season''' was won by [[Olympique de Marseille|Marseille]], with 55 points, for the third year in a row. A total of 20 clubs competed in the league. Bordeaux, Brest and Nice were all administratively relegated to [[1991–92 French Division 2|Division 2]] due to financial difficulties at the end of the season despite all finishing above the relegation zone.
